scenes.text: Your roommate snores like a chainsaw. And it's three A M.
So you, being a certified genius, slide a log into his bed.
By morning, it's firewood. Perfectly stacked.
Next night, ten logs. Then a whole tree, straight through the window.
You start a lumber company. He's your only employee. He has no idea.
You feed him an entire forest. Then every forest. You're a billionaire.
So you buy the one thing you've always wanted. A quiet cabin in the woods.
No trees. No oxygen. Now the whole planet is getting sleepy.
And the only one still awake, is you. Because,
